original.statement: The -tsdb.shipper.shared-store option is removed; if its value differed from object_store for a tsdb period, the index for that period becomes inaccessible until index tables are moved or copied to the object_store store.

decision.reason: [ev-af5a4b32c120] is in the upgrade-guide section "Removed `shared_store` and `shared_store_key_prefix` from shipper configuration". It names the flag exactly as `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store` and calls it "the deleted configuration option", so the subject is the cli-flag -tsdb.shipper.shared-store and the change type is removed. The render validator was inconclusive because the template failed to render, so it neither confirms nor contradicts this.
